escrow.cancelBeforeFundingDesc: No milestones funded yet. Either party can cancel.
escrow.cancelDesc: No milestones have been funded yet. This is reversible only by creating a new collaboration.
escrow.cancelPlaceholder: Why are you canceling? (Both parties + audit log will see this.)
escrow.checkoutCanceled: Checkout canceled. The milestone is still available to fund.
escrow.contractActionsDesc: Wrap up or back out of this contract once work has started.
escrow.declineDesc: As the worker, declining will refund all funded milestones to the employer and cancel the collaboration. No reviews window opens.
escrow.declinePlaceholder: Why are you declining the contract?
escrow.endDesc: Other party will have 7 days to contest. If silent, the contract auto-completes, the collab status moves to COMPLETED, and the review window opens.
escrow.fundingSubmitted: Funding submitted — waiting for Stripe confirmation. Status updates as soon as the webhook lands (usually a few seconds).
escrow.milestonesDesc: Add as many milestones as needed. Each one is funded, submitted, and approved independently. Only one milestone can be in flight at a time (Upwork pattern).
escrow.noEscrowDesc: An escrow contract is automatically created when the collaboration is confirmed.
escrow.privateDesc: Only the worker and employer parties can view the escrow surface for this collaboration.
escrow.title: Escrow

milestone.attachmentsHelp: (optional, up to {{count}} files: PDF/JPEG/PNG/WebP, ≤ 25 MB each)
milestone.fileTypeError: {{name}}: only PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP allowed.
milestone.titleError: Title must be at least 3 characters.

milestoneRow.autoReleasePassed: Auto-release window has passed — release will fire on the next sweep.
milestoneRow.declineConfirm: Decline milestone request "{{title}}"? The worker can re-request with different terms.
milestoneRow.deleteConfirm: Delete milestone "{{title}}"? This can't be undone.
milestoneRow.disputePlaceholder: Why are you disputing? (≥10 characters, visible to other party + moderator)
milestoneRow.disputeReasonError: Dispute reason must be at least 10 characters.
milestoneRow.heldNotice: The employer released {{amount}}, but we couldn't pay it out yet — your Stripe payout account isn't connected. Funds are held on the platform and will sweep to you the moment you finish setup.
milestoneRow.lockedNoticeSuffix: before funding this one. Only one milestone can be in flight at a time.
milestoneRow.onboardingPendingConfirm:
Worker hasn't completed payout setup yet. Funds will sit in escrow until they do — they'll be notified by email. You can refund anytime before they submit work.

Continue to checkout?
milestoneRow.payoutFailedNotice: Last payout attempt failed. Worker should fix their Stripe Connect account at /payments, then click Retry.
milestoneRow.refundReasonError: Refund reason must be at least 10 characters.
milestoneRow.reviewDaysLeft_one: {{count}} day left for employer review (auto-releases after).
milestoneRow.reviewDaysLeft_other: {{count}} days left for employer review (auto-releases after).
milestoneRow.submitMsgPlaceholder: Optional message to employer (e.g. 'Photos in chat')

onboarding.enabledBody: You're set up to receive funds. When an employer approves a milestone, payment goes straight to your linked bank account on Stripe's standard schedule (usually within 2 working days for UK accounts).
onboarding.incompleteBody: You've started Stripe Connect onboarding but haven't finished. Until it's complete, employers can't fund milestones for your work.
onboarding.setupBody: To receive payments for collaborations, you need to set up your Stripe Connect account. Stripe handles the verification and pays funds straight to your bank.
onboarding.stripeNotConfigured: Payments are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

page.activeEscrowDesc: Milestones currently in escrow waiting for your work or for the employer's approval.
page.confirmingSetup: We're confirming your payout setup with Stripe. This can take a few seconds — refresh in a moment if the status doesn't update.
page.employerSubtitle: Funds you've charged, refunds you've issued, and any open disputes on your milestones.
page.failedPayoutsDesc: These payouts couldn't go through. Fix your Stripe Connect setup above, then click "Retry payout" on each milestone.
page.heldDesc: The employer has released these milestones, but we couldn't pay you yet because your payout account isn't connected. Funds are safely held on the platform — complete onboarding above and they sweep to you automatically.
page.heldTitle: Held until you set up Stripe
page.ledgerDesc: Every charge and refund on your account, newest first.
page.noPaymentsDesc: Fund your first milestone and it will show up here.
page.openDisputesDesc: Milestones currently under dispute. Click through to respond or follow the resolution proposal.
page.pendingReferralDesc: Referral commission accumulated while your payouts were not yet enabled. Once you complete onboarding, these are paid out automatically on the next webhook.
page.releasedHistoryDesc: Funds released to your account via Stripe Connect.
page.title: Payments
page.workerSubtitle: Stripe Connect setup and every payout to your account.

disputeProposal.cancelConfirm: Cancel this dispute? The milestone will go back to its previous state and the other party will be notified.
disputeProposal.escalatedBody: In-platform mediation has ended. Our team will be in touch by email about next steps.
disputeProposal.awaitingBody: A staff mediator will propose a worker/employer split. You'll see it here and can Accept or Reject.
disputeProposal.cancelHint: Filed by mistake? You can pull it back as long as no one has responded yet. The milestone returns to its previous state.
disputeProposal.title: Mediator proposal
disputeProposal.notePlaceholder: Optional note (shown to the other party + mediator)
disputeProposal.youAccepted: You accepted this proposal — waiting on the other party.
disputeProposal.youRejected: You rejected this proposal — waiting on the other party.

reasonDialog.tooShort: Reason must be at least {{count}} characters.
